newsitem.title: USA: SIGNATURE BRANDS USA NAMES MEETA VYAS CEO.
newsitem.headline: SIGNATURE BRANDS USA NAMES MEETA VYAS CEO.

text.p: Signature Brands USA Inc Tuesday named Meeta Vyas, formerly of General Electric Co, chief executive officer.
The company said Vyas replaces Peter McC. Howell, who left to pursue other interests.
The company also named Thomas Shepherd, a managing director of Thomas H. Lee Co, chairman. Signature said Thomas H. Lee is the company's largest shareholder.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to elaborate on the management changes.
